notes.title: Beginner Support Missions Update Notice
notes.notes:
[h2]Beginner Support Missions Update Notice[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184099/b0b44d2aedf8cc146d5676e1972a904cfc8ba658.png[/img]
The Beginner Support Missions will be renewed on 7/9 (Wed)!

After the update, you'll be able to earn amazing rewards, including [Looking at You] Elfen Eri, Eri's Limit Break Crystal x4, and Premium Wish Tickets!

Even if you've already completed the current missions, you can challenge the renewed missions and earn the rewards again, so stay tuned!✨️

notes.title: Important Notice Regarding The Weekly Mission Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184099/b342ab371738f31dc0c2d3aae1a17f4bca55925f.png[/img]
The Weekly Missions will be updated on 2/26 (Wed) (UTC+9).

If you claim Point rewards from the current Weekly Missions between 2/24 (Mon) 4:00 and 2/26 (Wed) 9:59 (UTC+9), you will be unable to receive the updated Point rewards.

If you wish to receive the updated Point rewards, please wait until after the update on 2/26 (Wed) (UTC+9) to claim them.


[h2]Weekly Mission Update Notice[/h2]

We plan to update the Weekly Missions with the 2/26 (Wed) update!

With this update, the rewards will be even better than before 💪 
Be sure to try and complete them every week ✨️

▼Rewards Before Change
20 Points: Red Candy [4h] x1
40 Points: Regular Wish Ticket x1
60 Points: S or Higher Character Gift+ x5
80 Points: Member's Point x5
100 Points: Star Jewels x50

▼Rewards After Change
20 Points: Regular Wish Ticket x1
40 Points: Star Jewels x50
60 Points: S or Higher Character Gift+ x10
80 Points: Member's Point x50
100 Points: Star Jewels x100
